label: ROMAN EMPIRE
name: Rome: the complete 2,000-year history, from the Republic to the fall of Constantinople

chapters.heading: The Birth of Rome
chapters.about: from the legendary founding (753 BC) and the kings to the start of the Republic (509 BC) and early wars in Italy

chapters.heading: The Republic Conquers Italy
chapters.about: the Roman Republic, its consuls and senate, and the wars that made Rome master of Italy

chapters.heading: Rome Against Carthage
chapters.about: the Punic Wars: Hannibal crossing the Alps, Cannae, Scipio and Zama, and the destruction of Carthage

chapters.heading: Masters of the Mediterranean
chapters.about: expansion into Greece, Spain and the East; wealth, slaves and the crisis of the Republic (Gracchi, Marius, Sulla)

chapters.heading: Caesar and the First Emperor
chapters.about: Julius Caesar, the civil wars, his assassination, and Augustus becoming the first emperor

chapters.heading: The Golden Age
chapters.about: the Pax Romana, Trajan's conquests and the empire at its peak, roads, cities and law

chapters.heading: The Empire in Crisis
chapters.about: the third-century crisis, soldier emperors, Diocletian's Tetrarchy and Constantine

chapters.heading: East and West Split
chapters.about: the division of the empire, the barbarian invasions, the sack of Rome (410) and the fall of the West (476)

chapters.heading: Justinian's Dream
chapters.about: the Eastern Roman Empire, Justinian's reconquest, the plague, and the wars with Persia and the Arab conquests

chapters.heading: The Byzantine Empire
chapters.about: the medieval Byzantine Empire: Constantinople, Greek fire, the Macedonian dynasty and Basil II

chapters.heading: Crusades and Decline
chapters.about: Manzikert (1071), the Crusades, the sack of Constantinople in 1204 and the weakened empire

chapters.heading: The Last Days of Rome
chapters.about: the rise of the Ottomans and the fall of Constantinople in 1453, the end of 2,000 years of Rome
